title: Review a catalog draft: other states
summary: Three states of the catalog review step as frames: nothing to publish (the draft matches v9), a validation error pinned to its entry with the fix, and a publish that failed with nothing lost (devices still get v9, the draft is kept, Publish again).
compare: Nothing to publish: an empty state with one sentence of what happened and two ways out (Back to editing, Discard draft); Publish stays in place, disabled, described by the sentence.
A validation error is shown at its entry with the reason and the fix (Fix it opens the entry), never as a toast; Publish waits.
Publish failed: a danger callout says what failed and that nothing changed (devices still get v9, the draft is kept); the primary becomes 'Publish v10 again'.
Every frame uses the same header as config.catalog-review; no state introduces a second filled primary.
